_comment: Shipped retail vocabularies (D9). Delivered with every deployment; customers extend
them with an overlay rather than forking them (G10).
Terms here must be true of retail in general, not of one customer. A term that only
makes sense for a single deployment belongs in that deployment's overlay. The test to
apply before adding one: would the next retail customer recognise it without being
told what business we built it for?
